credentialTypes.containment: Keep only in the backend secret store; rotate after any client, source, artifact, or log exposure.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend inference proxy with user-scoped authorization and redacted provider receipts.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep only in the backend secret store; never return it from runtime or session endpoints.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend voice proxy or a provider-issued subject/device-bound short-lived broker token.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep only in the backend secret store and rotate after exposure.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend provider adapter; no mobile credential fallback.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep only in the backend secret store; do not package it in LocalConfig or Info.plist.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend realtime broker when the provider supports real TTL, scope, audience, and revoke; otherwise disable direct realtime voice.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep only in the backend secret store; never return the static token to iOS.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend-created product session or provider-supported revocable mobile session credential.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep in the backend secret store with least privilege and rotation receipts.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend Tencent adapter; no client-side cloud account secret.

credentialTypes.containment: Retire from mobile builds and restrict legacy use while user and service identities are rolled out.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Opaque user sessions for user routes and scoped short-lived service principals for service routes.

credentialTypes.containment: Keep the signing key in server secret storage; distribute only public identifiers to clients.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Backend APNs provider adapter with key version and delivery receipts.

credentialTypes.containment: Public identifier; retain type classification so it is not confused with a secret.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: No replacement required; continue to bind it to server-side credentials and policy.

credentialTypes.containment: Public identifier; do not treat it as proof of authorization.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: No replacement required; authorization still requires a backend session.

credentialTypes.containment: Public asset identifier; bind it to an authorized backend session and release policy.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: No replacement required; keep QA overrides debug-only.

credentialTypes.containment: Block release until an owner classifies and contains the credential.
credentialTypes.replacementPath: Classify as public identifier, placeholder, or owned secret before release.
